title: Servers with open critical incidents
description: For each server_name, calculate open_incidents as rows with resolved = 0 and critical_open as unresolved rows with severity = critical. Keep only servers with at least one critical_open incident. Return exactly three columns: server_name, open_incidents, critical_open. Sort by critical_open DESC, open_incidents DESC, server_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT server_name
FROM incidents
GROUP BY server_name
hints: Two SUM(CASE ...) expressions can produce the two counters.
Resolved incidents must contribute to neither open_incidents nor critical_open.
solution_explanation: Conditional aggregation separates total open incident load from critical incidents.
